title: BooleanValueDisplayDescriptor
description: Display metadata for one boolean state (true, false, or null) of a page column.
markdownDescription: AI guidance: set only the fields you want to override. `displayName` replaces the default Yes/No/empty label, `color` is used by badge presentation (hex or CSS color), and `icon` is used by badge/iconOnly presentation. A `null` value for a field explicitly clears an inherited value when the page extends a lower model layer.

displayName.description: Label for this boolean state, for example 'Active' or 'Inactive'.

color.description: Badge color for this state, for example '#16A34A'.

icon.description: Icon for this state used by badge and iconOnly presentations.
